Players Committee [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]] Appendix A — Errata (PDF dated 30 July 2023): changes “If any bounty hunter” to “If your bounty hunter”. Printed text: [[Res Luk Ra'auf]]. The PC text also appears in the 2022 Advanced Rulebook (v3.28, PDF page 122). The first issue date is unknown.
|notes=* Players Committee [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]] Appendix A — Errata, Res Luk Ra'auf.
* The Holotable D-E1 face [[:File:Dagobah-D-reslukraauf.gif]] prints this wording; GEMP <code>Card4_146</code> plays it.
* Decipher's [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998, PDF pages 112–113) already ruled that this Interrupt “must be played on your own lone bounty hunter” to add to your battle destiny.
* Printed face: [[Res Luk Ra'auf]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata#PC Errata|Errata — PC Errata]].
